question: Who lost the 2021 NBA Finals? Show a table including the winner, loser and final series score.
raw_answer:
The loser of the 2021 NBA Finals was the Phoenix Suns.

| Winner | Loser | Final Series Score |
|---|---|---|
| Milwaukee Bucks | Phoenix Suns | 4–2 | [1]

5 things we learned from Bucks' championship runGiannis Antetokounmpo has what it takes to be the face of the league, while Milwaukee makes a small-market statement.

Finals MVP Ladder: Giannis realizes his dreamThe Bucks superstar realizes his long-sought dream in walking away with Finals MVP honors.

Sun sets on Phoenix's turnaround seasonPhoenix came up short in The Finals but has the foundation and talent to make another deep playoff run in 2021-22.

The Wrap: Complete coverage of Game 6Catch up on all the highlights, analysis and postgame sound from Game 6 of the 2021 NBA Finals.

24 Thoughts on Game 6 of The FinalsInstant observations and real-time tweets from Game 6 of The Finals as it happened in Milwaukee on Tuesday night.

Finals recap: Key moments from each gameThe Milwaukee Bucks defeated the Phoenix Suns 4-2 in the NBA Finals.

2021 NBA Finals Mini-Movie: Game 6The celebration was 50 years in the making. Take a cinematic look back at Giannis Antetokounmpo's iconic game as the Bucks win the 2021 title.

Finals Film Room: Giannis, Middleton shine in clincherGiannis Antetokounmpo turns in a historic 50-point performance and Khris Middleton hits clutch buckets late in Game 6.

Ultimate Highlight: Bucks win first title in 50 yearsMilwaukee wins its first NBA title in 50 years behind an unbelieveable 50-point effort from its superstar, Giannis Antetokounmpo.

Giannis leads Bucks to first title in 50 yearsIn a career-defining game, Giannis Antetokounmpo scores 50 and gets just enough help from his teammates to oust Phoenix in Game 6.

Stats & facts to know from Bucks' title runThe Bucks piled up several stats feats as they collected their first NBA title since 1971.

NBA Twitter reacts to Bucks winning titleGiannis Antetokounmpo erupts for 50 points as the Bucks close out the Suns 105-98 in Game 6 to win their first NBA championship since 1971.
